$comment: Witnesses whose evidence changed when the quotient gained a declared codomain (ANALYTICAL-QUOTIENT-CODOMAIN-AUTHORITY-01). Each is HELD OPEN, not decided: no standing moves because this file exists. The ledger may only shrink — `necessity.test.ts` refuses an entry whose witness holds again, and refuses a non-holding witness that is not listed, so neither a stale entry nor a new failure can hide here. What remains is one defect seen twice: A HOLE IS OBSERVABLE WHERE AN ABSENCE WAS NOT. Deleting a required discriminator destroyed the evidence that betrays its branch; holing it leaves that evidence standing. The old erasures did not hold these coordinates apart — they hid the residue by destroying it, and nobody had stated that as the argument. Reverting to deletion is refused on its own terms: it produces images the representation cannot express (`quotientLanguageInvalid`), which is what this spec exists to end.

awaiting.detail: The pair is FX_TEMP_RATIO_COMPARISON against FX_N_TEMP_MEAN. `assertion.aggregate.op` is branch-qualified — the slot exists only where kind is `aggregate` — so after both erasures the aggregate side carries `op: <hole>` and the ratio-comparison side carries no `op` slot at all. The PRESENCE of the hole betrays the branch that the `kind` erasure was supposed to forget. Deletion hid this by removing the slot; it did not forget it.
awaiting.repair: This is exactly the residue the closure form exists to normalize: a `forget-branch-field` carrier over the aggregate branch's `op`, carrier `assertion.kind:aggregate~ratio-comparison`, is the named mechanism. No such carrier is ledgered in closures-stage2.json -- its 22 carriers are relation.derivedBy.kind and field.additivity.kind pairs. One is mechanically derivable (residue aggregate:[op], unilateral, minRawEdit 2, footprint of 7 coordinates), and measured directly on this pair the carrier plus that normalization collides the stimuli while the carrier alone leaves `assertions.0.op` and the normalization alone leaves `assertions.0.kind`. Promoting it is a closure adjudication, not a witness repair, and two facts stand in the way: all 7 footprint coordinates hold primitive standing, so obligation 8 fails and the carrier cannot be proven primitive through this closure (composite constructor vs derived discriminator must be re-decided); and the checker cannot evaluate obligation 3 for an assertion holder -- forgetPath("assertion") throws because no locator is keyed by that holder path. The throw is a checker limit, not a verdict on the closure.

awaiting.detail: The same pair and the same residue as above, reached through the member-class spelling instead of the whole-leaf one: both sides carry `kind` as the class {aggregate, ratio-comparison}, and the aggregate side still carries `op: <hole>` that the other side has no slot for. That the two spellings fail identically is the point — the residue is a property of the branch structure, not of which erasure names it.
awaiting.repair: The same derivable carrier settles both entries; the entry above records the ledger fact (no assertion carrier is ledgered), the direct collision measurement and the two blocks on promotion. If it is promoted, this entry and the one above close together; if it is refused, both coordinates lose their present evidence together.
